x, y, n = map(float, input().split())

min_diff = 1e9
best_a = 0
best_b = 1

for b in range(1, int(n) + 1):
    a1 = int(-(-b * x / y // 1))  # ceiling
    a2 = int(b * x / y // 1)     # floor

    diff_a2 = abs(x / y - a2 / b)
    if diff_a2 < min_diff:
        min_diff = diff_a2
        best_a = a2
        best_b = b

    diff_a1 = abs(x / y - a1 / b)
    if diff_a1 < min_diff:
        min_diff = diff_a1
        best_a = a1
        best_b = b

print(f"{best_a}/{best_b}")
</translated_code>
